title: A First Primer on Holding the Sai
summary: Teaches a beginner the sai grip with jab and guard drills that need body strength alone.

title: Handbook of the Forked Truncheon
summary: A short handbook on stopping a stick or blade with the tines and answering with the butt.

title: The Three-Point Workbook
summary: Workbook drills for striking with all three points of the sai and changing grip between them.

title: Elements of Catching an Edge with the Tines
summary: Explains how to catch a blade between the tines and twist it using only wrist and forearm strength.

title: A Plain Treatise on Sai in Both Hands
summary: Trains a student to carry a sai in each hand and trade guard and strike between them.

title: The Yoke and Shaft Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of short light-qi strikes and catches that lets a first-stage cultivator fight with sai.

title: Canon of the Short Truncheon Guard
summary: Sets out the guard postures of the sai and shows how a little circulating qi stiffens each one.

title: Pocket Lessons in Sai Carrying and Stance
summary: Short lessons on carrying the sai and standing ready so that it comes to hand quickly.

title: The Reverse-Grip Primer
summary: A primer on the reverse grip with the shaft along the forearm and qi lending weight to each blow.

title: A Workbook of Tine Catches and Turns
summary: Workbook of tine catches and wrist turns that use light qi to hold a blade fast.
